svg.text: Landing and integration: differentiation 7, complexity 8, core.
Worker profiles and adapters: differentiation 5, complexity 4, supporting.
Bet B1: A deterministic daemon with earned leases replaces the LLM orchestrator, and no task stalls silently. (The lease misreads
activity: a slow but healthy worker loses its lease, or the fleet clock or the awake time from the platform layer is wrong on 1
OS (discover H13, answered by design A25).).
Bet B2: Parallel features with trial merges, stacking and resolver tasks reach the primary branch through 1 pull request each,
with no hand reconciliation. (Resolver tasks grow past their size limit, or stacking chains features so 1 slow feature holds
Bet B3: Pacing dispatch to each pool's usage window, with fallback personas, uses the subscription usage fully and burns no
attempt on a usage limit. (No target for 'full use' exists (understand Q1), so the bet cannot fail visibly.).
